model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss over iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", is linear and spans from 0 to 140,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", is linear and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4. Each model is represented by a distinct colored line with a unique marker and style: Vanilla is a purple dashed line; StrmLLM (n=64) is a blue solid line; SepLLM (n=64) is an orange solid line; SepLLM (n=64, H) is a green solid line; SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is a red solid line; and SepLLM (n=128) is a dark blue solid line. All lines begin at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and decrease over time, stabilizing around a loss value of approximately 2.5 after about 100,000 iterations. The Vanilla model starts with the highest loss and declines most rapidly, while the SepLLM (n=128) model begins with the lowest loss and shows the slowest decline. The other models show intermediate behaviors, with SepLLM (n=64, H/T) and SepLLM (n=64, H) generally tracking closely together and slightly below the SepLLM (n=64) baseline.
